records.source: Reads the per-well phenotype cell tables, calls the model (fine-tuned on the user's labels when given), takes G1 / S / G2 from :func:`_dna_phases`, runs :func:`self_checks`, collapses failed stages over every plate of the screen in ``db`` and writes ``ops_cell_cycle`` (one row per cell), ``ops_cell_cycle_checks`` (one row per plate and check) and ``ops_cell_cycle_report_<plate>.html``.
